news.summary: Boston is supposed to be the medical capital of America. Yet many don’t have primary care access, hurting their ability to get treatments, screenings, and medical advice.

news.summary: The report analyzed athenahealth data across 12.3 million rural patients between 2021 and 2025.

news.title: Academic hospital heads petition Congress for 2-year delay to CMS' 340B cuts
news.summary: A reimbursement change finalized this month would hit 340B hospitals for nearly $5.5 billion, with academic institutions shouldering more than half of the impact, 95 executives of academic institutions wrote to congressional leaders.

news.summary: The IDR Gateway replaces the web forms providers, payers and other parties previously used to trigger and pursue payment arbitration under the Independent Dispute Resolution process.

news.title: WebMD Ignite brings OpenAI’s ChatGPT to platform for healthcare advertising
news.summary: The new collaboration combines direct platform support with healthcare advertising campaign strategies, the companies say.

news.title: WTW: Global health insurance costs set to rise 10.2% next year
news.summary: Global health insurance costs are set to rise by double digits in 2027 for the second straight year, according to a new survey.

news.title: HHS: Medicaid state-directed payment savings 'primarily' stem from slowing growth
news.summary: A policy analysis and commentary from the department showed an estimated 7.8% of all state-directed payment spending went to rural hospitals in FY2025, and that 92.1% of estimated savings from industry-opposed statutory rate limits reflect projected spending above that year's $11.5 billion total.

news.title: Unpacking the implications from CMS' latest proposed Medicare Advantage changes
news.summary: Analysts dove into the beefy regulation, and project that changes to MA's star ratings program would likely cull more than $100 billion in federal spending over the next decade.

news.title: Schrödinger signs €22M biologics collab with sequencing automation outfit Enpicom

news.title: FDA issues noncompliance letters to 2 biotechs over lack of trial data reporting

news.title: Finnish biotech delivers durable symptom relief in phase 2 birch pollen allergy trial
news.summary: A phase 2 trial of Desentum’s birch pollen allergen immunotherapy has hit its primary endpoint, teeing up further study of a short-course medication that could provide a persistent effect.

news.title: ‘The potential is there’: BetterLife’s LSD cousin mirrors neuroplasticity in mice without the hallucinations
news.summary: With the boom in researching psychedelics to treat neurological conditions, scientists have begun to explore ways to alter these drugs to remove the hallucinogenic effects while salvaging the neuroplastic tendencies of these drugs.

news.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific nabs FDA expanded use clearance for EXENT analyser system
news.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific announced FDA clearance for expanded intended use of its EXENT Analyser with the EXENT GAM Assay.

news.title: ARM CEO reflects on ‘wild 12 months’ pushing back on FDA’s shifting gene therapy stance
news.summary: When Fierce first met up with Tim Hunt back in November 2025, the CEO of the Alliance for Regenerative Medicine (ARM)—which represents over 400 members, including biotechs—was optimistic that cell and gene therapies were high on the government’s agenda.

news.title: DiaMedica shares signs that drug extends pregnancy in fetal growth restriction trial
news.summary: DiaMedica Therapeutics has shared phase 2 results in severe early-onset fetal growth restriction, reporting that most participants with known delivery dates remained pregnant longer than expected.

news.title: Why Iambic’s CEO believes preclinical cancer therapy could be ‘holy grail’ for CDK inhibitors
news.summary: Fresh off a $150 million IPO, Iambic Therapeutics has unveiled preclinical data for a potential challenger in one of oncology's most competitive drug classes: cyclin-dependent kinases.

news.title: ‘We’ve been a quiet company’: Why viral biotech Vyriad attracts Big Pharmas despite low profile
news.summary: Vyriad's leadership may describe the biotech as a “very quiet company” when compared to some of its more buzzy peers, but the drug developer's partnerships speak for themselves.

news.title: FDA signs off on Siemens Healthineers next gen multiple sclerosis blood test
news.summary: The FDA has given de novo marketing authorization for Siemens Healthineers’ Atellica IM Neurofilament Light Chain (NfL) assay.

news.title: GE HealthCare launches ViewPoint Ultra to simplify ultrasound workflows
news.summary: GE HealthCare has launched ViewPoint Ultra, an ultrasound workflow solution designed to help health systems standardize clinical documentation and reporting across sites and departments while supporting specialized individual care needs.

papers.title: Guarding with Judgment: Learning to Intervene for Multimodal Safety
papers.summary: When visual context makes an ordinary request unsafe to answer as asked, a blanket refusal may leave the user's need unresolved. Choosing how to help requires distinguishing an established hazard from a condition that still needs verification, a distinction that binary safety labels leave unspecified. We formulate this decision through four actions: allow, warn, review, and refuse. papers.title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration
papers.summary: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision.
